behavior.branch_order: tag == 0 (full 64-bit test) first, then tag low 32 bits == 1, then the zero fall-through

edges.tag_1_cap: min(saturating_sub(field+0x10, field+0x18), field+0x28) with difference > cap

behavior.tag_1: min(saturating_sub(field+0x10, field+0x18), field+0x28), where saturating_sub is field+0x10 - field+0x18 when field+0x10 >= field+0x18, else 0
behavior.tag_test_asymmetry: tag-0 test reads the full 64-bit tag (test rax,rax); tag-1 test reads only the low 32 bits (cmp $0x1,%eax); 0x100000001 takes the tag-1 path, 0x100000000 falls through to 0

coordinate_system: ELF virtual addresses, no runtime rebase
